purpose: E1 acceptance for K_v2 with the primitive in use, replacing tabletop_checkpoint_check_20261116_001 (not run: TP03_near_1161300 was rejected at prepare, outside_table:cup_1). Every stage-boundary checkpoint of an episode whose locate goes through the K3 primitive resumes to the same episode, replaying the source episode's cached replies (replay=True). Harness check only.
task_choice: Unchanged rule of _20261116_001, applied to ready instances: the first ready generated instance of each of the two templates with the full chain (TP03_near_1161300 and _1161301 were rejected at prepare). The smoke outcomes of these episodes were known when this config was written; the rule does not use them.
physical_episodes: one fresh source episode per task (live model calls) plus one resume per written checkpoint (at most 10 per task, no model calls)
prediction: Every resume reproduces its source episode under tabletop.same_episode, with no ReplayCacheMiss: the locate and prepare relocate frames render to the same bytes, so both replies come from the source episode's vlm_cache. The fresh source episodes may differ from the smoke episodes of the same task (model replies are not byte-identical across calls); that is not checked here.
falsification: Any ReplayCacheMiss (the replayed frame differs from the source frame) or any differing record. Either blocks K_v2 use in checkpoint-based work (entry library, reach trials) until the cause is found.
